extension.description: Alle Sendungen der Rocket Beans TV Mediathek durchsuchen, Favoriten verwalten und Folgen abspielen. Die Wiedergabe erfolgt über das YouTube-Add-on.
Browse all shows of the Rocket Beans TV media library, keep a list of favourites, search by title and play episodes. Playback uses the YouTube add-on.
extension.disclaimer: Inoffizielles Add-on, keine Verbindung zur Rocket Beans Entertainment GmbH. "Rocket Beans TV" ist deren Marke.
Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with Rocket Beans Entertainment GmbH. "Rocket Beans TV" is their trademark.
extension.news:
v0.9.4 - Unexpected API responses show an error message instead of a script error
v0.9.3 - Safe file writes when several add-on instances run at once - No episode count instead of a wrong one when the API omits it
v0.9.2 - Search results stay open after changing a favourite - Failed favourite saves are reported instead of ignored - The favourites dialog saves the whole selection at once
v0.9.1 - Menus and dialogs are translated (English and German) - Episode dates follow the Kodi region settings - Licence file is shipped with the add-on
